newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Aug commodity futures volume down year/year.
newsitem.headline: Japan Aug commodity futures volume down year/year.

text.p: Futures trading volume on Japan's 12 commodities exchanges totalled 5,005,775 lots in August, down 22.8 percent from a year earlier and down 18.0 percent from July, the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges said on Tuesday.
Of these, volume in precious metal futures declined sharply, pressured by a static currency market and dollar-based precious metal prices, a Federation official said.
The total volume of precious metal contracts on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange in August fell by 68.0 percent from a year earlier and was down by 24.9 percent from July to 794,331 lots.
Of the total, the volume of yen-based corn futures on the Tokyo Grain Exchange was the largest, totalling 1,330,361 lots traded in August.
